# Natural Earth land polygons (used by Fig 1)

- **File:** `ne_50m_land.geojson`, the land polygons at 1:50 million scale.
- **Source:** Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com), via the `nvkelso/natural-earth-vector` repository, release tag **v5.1.2**: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/v5.1.2/geojson/ne_50m_land.geojson`.
- **Downloaded:** 10 Nov 2026 (1,636,166 bytes, 1,420 polygons).
- **Licence:** public domain. Natural Earth: "All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain."
- **Use:** coastline and land only, drawn by `src/paper_figures.fig1_map_coverage`. No country or regional boundaries are drawn (D73).
